gitCommit.subject: Replace scaffold favicon and brand-slide social image with the logo
gitCommit.body:
Replace scaffold favicon and brand-slide social image with the logo

The favicon was still Rails' generated placeholder — public/icon.svg and
icon.png were byte-for-byte identical to the app generator templates, so
every tab showed a red circle. The same file was the Organization logo in
three JSON-LD blocks, which is what Google has been served as our mark.

Separately, og:image pointed at vittio_new_with_description.jpg, a slide
from the brand-guidelines deck (wordmark over a blurred background, with
hex codes and a bullet list). It was a hardcoded local in the layout, so
articles could not override it — a post with a hero image still shared
the brand slide.

- Add v-icon.svg/.png (indigo v on a white tile) and apple-touch-icon.png,
  built from the v glyph in vittio_new_without_background.svg. New
  filenames rather than in-place replacement: production serves public/
  with max-age=1.year, so returning visitors would keep the cached red
  dot at the old URLs.
- Add og-image.png, a 1200x630 card with the two-tone wordmark on white.
  The layout has always declared those dimensions; now they are true.
- Make og:image and og:image:alt overridable via content_for, and emit
  the dimension tags only for the default card. Articles with a hero now
  share it, with the title as alt text.
- Fix the default alt, which described the image as a dashboard.
- Delete app/views/pwa/, dead since nothing routes to it; the live
  service worker is public/sw.js.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
